name: Ivno Payment Gateway with Instant Approval
author: ivno

sections.description:
This plugin integrates the Ivno Payment Gateway, allowing you to easily accept Credit/Debit Cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Customers can pay securely via the method of their choice, and you receive instant payouts to your configured USDC wallet via blockchain smart contracts. This plugin connects to the Ivno API and requires a merchant account from ivno.io.

NEW: Includes a powerful Cart Abandonment Recovery feature that automatically prompts users to save their checkout link via email before they leave the page, helping you recover lost revenue effortlessly.

External services

This plugin relies on the Ivno API (app.ivno.io) as a third-party service to securely process payments and handle cart abandonment recovery.

  • Purpose: To securely generate payment routing links, calculate real-time fiat-to-crypto conversions, and process cart abandonment email captures.
  • Data Sent: When a customer checks out, the plugin sends the order amount, currency, order ID, and the customer’s billing email to the Ivno API to generate the secure payment link.
  • Service Provider: This service is provided by Ivno.
  • Terms of Service: https://app.ivno.io/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://app.ivno.io/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ivno-payment-gateway folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and select ‘Ivno Payment Gateway’.
  4. Enable the gateway and enter the API Key and API Secret provided in your Ivno Merchant Dashboard.
  5. Copy the Webhook URL displayed at the bottom of the settings page and paste it into your Ivno Merchant Dashboard (under Global Webhook URL) to receive automated order status updates.
  6. Save changes.

1.6.1

  • Fixed PHP 8.2 deprecation warning regarding dynamic property creation during plugin activation.

1.6.0

  • Completely obfuscated checkout URLs to remove all WordPress routing traces.
  • Added full subscription editing and management to the Merchant Dashboard.
  • Synchronized Net Payout calculations across all views for perfect accuracy.
  • Improved UI for quick link generation and copying.

1.5.1

  • Unified description for WordPress repository standards.
  • Added mandatory external services disclosure to documentation.
  • Localized gateway icon to comply with WordPress.org remote asset policies.
  • Added an auto-generated Webhook URL display in the plugin settings for easier merchant dashboard configuration.

1.5.0

  • Added robust Cart Abandonment Recovery feature with slide-in email capture and automated follow-ups.
  • Upgraded the non-custodial decentralized split routing for instant merchant payouts on the blockchain.
  • Major UI improvements to the Merchant Dashboard and API tables.
  • Added native support for WooCommerce Subscriptions.

1.4.0

  • Fixed WordPress.org Plugin Check standard validations.
  • Unslashed and sanitized server headers for incoming webhook signatures.
  • Escaped variables and properly aligned text domains to bypass repository trademark slug filters.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
